notes.title: You can gather Steam trading cards in Siege now!
notes.notes:
It would be quite awkward if we had a card game without Steam trading cards. So good news everyone, we've straightened out our awkwardness and now you can earn Steam trading cards in Siege and all the added goodies that come with them:
[list]
[*]Siege themed badges
[*]Siege themed emoticons to express your rage, flame or occasional good mood in message boards
[*]Siege themed backgrounds
[/list]
Have fun gathering cards while gathering cards!

notes.title: Siege now available for Linux and Mac operating systems!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357398/5f0d6da8c30ff85743ea536bec6b8cf6520ea588.jpg[/img]

Good news everyone!

It turns out people are interested in the opportunity to Siege castles also on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]Mac operating systems[/b]. So we've updated the game and now Siege is available also for gamers who prefer these operating systems.
